slice: RPP-5kd selected single-element append to a consumed MLINESTYLE
scope: Extends the selected AC1027 open, uncut, unfilled MLINE projector to one tail element appended to a source-bound MLINESTYLE already used by ordinary MLINE consumers. It updates group-73 style element count and projects the added per-vertex segment parameters. This is selected output/geometry evidence, not native CAD semantic qualification or whole-document support.

references.use: Group 73 is the number of MLINESTYLE elements; group 74 gives the repeated parameter count per element at each segment; group 41 carries those parameters; group 75/42 carry area-fill parameter counts and values. The first group-41 value is the distance along the miter vector to the element path intersection.
Group 49 is the MLINESTYLE element offset; the selected projection is limited to flag 2.

contract.admission: The input MLINESTYLE body, original element prefix, style dictionary/provider graph and every ordinary MLINE consumer must be source-bound. Exactly one element is appended at the tail to a modern AC1027 style with an unchanged existing prefix and supported appended element fields. Existing source MLINE count must match the original style count; every consumer must remain live, in its original scope and model-identical during preflight. The selected projector requires two or more existing elements, equal unchanged start/end angles and flag 2. Removal, multi-element append, retarget-plus-append, other geometry edits and unqualified carriers refuse.
contract.geometry: The selected MLINE must be open, have at least two vertices, positive finite scale, justification 1 or 2, unit extrusion, source-consistent WCS positions/directions/miters, exactly two group-41 parameters per existing element with a zero second value, and no group-42 fill values. Existing first group-41 parameters are revalidated against the original style. Their output values are recalculated using the complete target style offset set, including any changed bottom-justification shift. The appended element receives a derived pair [miter-distance, 0] at each vertex and an empty fill-parameter list. The projected MLINE element count is increased by one without mutating the caller model.
contract.identityAndOutput: The MLINE retains its existing group-2 name and group-340 style reference. The output proof checks group-73 count 3, all nine group-74 counts, all eighteen group-41 values, nine zero group-75 counts, absence of group 42, and the target style's three group-49 offsets. Fresh import verifies three style elements, three parameter arrays per vertex, and unchanged WCS geometry, directions, miters, scale and extrusion.
contract.failureAndRetry: An unsupported flag profile refuses before publication and preserves a destination sentinel and caller state; correcting the flag permits a successful same-adapter retry. A late live-consumer parameter mutation after entity emission also refuses before publication; restoring the caller state permits a successful same-adapter retry. The successful output is reopened for semantic field readback.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. ASCII/binary routes remain supported. Source and output drawings are generated at runtime and removed after success; no DWG/DXF fixture was committed.
contract.limits: Evidence covers AC1027 ASCII and binary sources crossed with ASCII and binary output, one consumed-style 2-to-3 tail append, flags 2, equal angles, the open/unfilled/un-cut projector, one model-space and one named-block consumer, three vertices, center and bottom justification, and two extrusion planes. It does not qualify count removal, multi-element append, append combined with other style edits, other versions, other MLINE schemas/carriers, native CAD rendering, document closure or independent 3D semantics. No support claim is promoted.

controls.styleAndConsumerProfile: Generated source has two style elements at offsets 1.25/-0.75 and two three-vertex ordinary MLINEs. A tail element with offset -1.25, ACI 4 and ByLayer linetype is appended. Its lower offset changes bottom justification's minimum-offset shift; the test verifies that existing element parameters are rebased as well as the new element parameters.
controls.failureAndRetry: Four source/output profiles and eight successful readbacks; two unsupported-flag refusals preserve sentinels/caller state and are corrected on the same adapter; two late-mutation refusals preserve sentinels and are followed by same-adapter retry.

selectedRegression.summary: 4 source/output profiles; 8 successful readbacks; 2 unsupported-flag refusals; 2 late-mutation refusals; 4 same-adapter retries

affectedMlineCohort.summary: 6/6: MLINESTYLE transactions, geometry guard, source/live guard, consumed-style offset projection, offset-only 340 retarget projection, and consumed-style append projection
